lines: A few straps snapped and a few nerves did too, but the village held.
Leather remembers every cut. So do people. This one may be remembered kindly.
You helped keep more than roofs intact. People held together because of it.
The village came through worn, but not torn apart.
I saw courage stretched tight and not snapping. Yours included.
Raiders test every weak point. You became a strong one.
I can repair gear. You helped spare things that can't be repaired as easily.
The doors, straps, and nerves all held better because you fought.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
